description.value: Singapore Hawker is a Singaporean and Malaysian hawker-style restaurant with locations in Coquitlam and Burnaby, recognized as one of Canada's 50 Most Loved restaurants by DoorDash in 2022. The menu draws on more than 25 years of the head chef's experience in Singaporean and Malaysian kitchens, featuring dishes like roti canai, pandan leaf chicken, Nyonya chicken claypot, and a range of rich curries. Dine-in, takeout, delivery, and large-format party trays are all available, making it a flexible stop for hungry cyclists.
